summary: Iron Rabbit v157 — verified (1) Nightly Countdown Chip and (2) Uncategorized cross-category toast label. Countdown chip cases 1-5 all PASS via IndexedDB seeding + reload. Regression on OFF menu/Turn ON/Cancel PASS. Service worker cache name confirmed iron-rabbit-v157. Uncategorized toast: code path verified via source review at NotesApp.jsx L1560 (MOVE) and L1588 (COPY) — both compute `dstLabel = dstCat || 'Uncategorized'` so empty-string dstCat now renders as 'Uncategorized' in both toasts; trailing '· Hold ⌘/Ctrl to move' preserved on COPY. Live rbd drag simulation was not executed (droppables not available post-reload in test surface).
critical_code_review_comments: notificationService.js `nextFocusStart` correctly iterates 0..7 day offsets, honours master schedule.enabled, skips today when start <= curMinutes, and returns null when nothing scheduled in the next 7 days. Reuses DAY_KEYS + parseHHMM cleanly.
FocusStatusChip.jsx OFF-state label logic gated by `nextStartTs && (nextStartTs - Date.now()) <= 24*60*60*1000` — falls back to 'Focus · off' otherwise, matching spec.
Countdown tick useEffect: interval runs when `active || (!active && focusSchedule?.enabled)`. Uses 30 s cadence — spec says '~30 s', matches.
NotesApp.jsx L1560 & L1588: `const dstLabel = dstCat || 'Uncategorized'` applied to both MOVE and COPY toasts. Trailing ' · Hold ⌘/Ctrl to move' on COPY unchanged.
service-worker.js CACHE_NAME = 'iron-rabbit-v157' — verified live via caches.keys() (['iron-rabbit-v157']).
Pre-existing (unrelated) hydration warning: <button> inside <button> in CategoryGroup/HierarchyPathButton persists. Not introduced by this iteration but should be fixed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for countdown + regression; toast branch verified by source review only

seed_data_creation: Seeded IndexedDB (IronRabbit → settings store, key 'app_settings' out-of-line) with 5 different focus_schedule shapes and reloaded page between cases. NOTE for next agent: `store.put(value, 'app_settings')` — must pass explicit key since keyPath is null.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IndexedDB 'IronRabbit' → store 'settings' has keyPath=null, autoIncrement=false — pass key explicitly to put(). Chip data-testid='focus-status-chip'; inner_text() on the button element yields the label. `nextFocusStart` skips today when start <= curMinutes (STRICT >, not >=). Uncategorized droppableId = CAT_PREFIX + '' (i.e. 'notes-in-'), producing dstCat === ''.
